bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for a grant to the Hmong American Mediation Center.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HMONG AMERICAN MEDIATION CENTER.

$75,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Hmong American Mediation Center to provide culturally specific dialog and outreach.
